items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-08-22
items.q: You know, we were just talking about Mrs. Barnes about how Miele used to practice.

ctx.x: You know, we were just talking about Mrs. Barnes about how Miele used to practice. Yeah. You mind telling that again? Used to practice early in the morning, you say?
Yeah. Used to practice early in the morning. That was his beginning. You see, before he'd done anything in the morning, when he'd first get up, that's what he'd done.
